newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA ANNOUNCES SUPPLY SIDE INVESTMENT MEASURES.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA ANNOUNCES SUPPLY SIDE INVESTMENT MEASURES.

text.p: South Africa's Department of Trade and Industry said on Wednesday it was launching two supply-side industrial incentive programmes designed to encourage investment.

Under the Tax Holiday Scheme, new investments in manufacturing with assets exceeding three million rand will be zero taxed for six years, if they meet qualifying criteria including human resources, location and industry sector.

The Small/Medium Manufacturing Development Scheme, which replaces the existing Simplified Regional Industrial Development Programme, will allow firms investing three million rand to qualify for start-up grants.
